AMB.hook: You measure every choice against what you stand to gain. Ambition is the only honest currency.

CAUSE.hook: Something bigger than personal gain drives you forward. The cost is irrelevant.

REL.hook: The people you care about are the only thing worth protecting in this galaxy.

BELIEF.hook: A set of beliefs shapes how you see the galaxy and your role in it.

CONNECT.hook: A bond — to a group, a place, or an ideal — draws you into the fight.

QUEST.hook: You seek something specific, and nothing will stop you from finding it.

DISCOVERY.hook: The need to see what lies beyond the next star drives you into the unknown.

CONFLICT.hook: You are defined by the battles you choose. Every confrontation sharpens you.

CREATION.hook: Survival demands ingenuity. You build what the galaxy needs to endure.

FAITH.hook: A deep trust in something greater than yourself guides your every step.

REWARD.hook: Credits, salvage, or favors — you move the goods and collect what you are owed.

CREED.hook: Your words carry weight. You lead by principle, not by force.

OATH.hook: You put preservation first, acting in the interests of others before yourself.

DRIVE.hook: An inner fire pushes you forward — restless, relentless, always moving.

LOCALEEN.hook: Aleen is a world of hidden depths.

LOCDEV.hook: Devaron is home to one of the galaxy’s .

INNOV.hook: Every problem is an engineering challenge. You find the solution no one else sees.

PURSUIT.hook: Your goals dominate your desires. When you set your sights, nothing distracts you.

INJUSTICE.hook: The galaxy is full of wrongs. You are compelled to set them right.

CODE.hook: A personal code governs your actions — lines you will not cross, duties you will not abandon.

GROWTH.hook: You reject complacency. Every day is a chance to be better than yesterday.

IMPROVE.hook: Nothing cannot be improved with thought and effort. You prove it daily.

MYSTERY.hook: The most fundamental questions of the universe call to you. Understanding is everything.

CHALLENGE.hook: You rise to every test. Challenges hone your skills and prove your worth.

SECRET.hook: Secrets are your currency. You uncover what others would keep hidden.

THEACE.hook: Born in the cockpit, the Ace turns starships and speeders into extensions of sheer will.

BOUNT.hook: Tracks fugitives across the galaxy, bringing targets in alive — or not.

CLONE.hook: Engineered for war, Clone Soldiers fight in every role the Republic demands of them.

COLO.hook: Educated, resourceful, and hopelessly far from home — the Outer Rim reshapes everyone it touches.

COMMANDER.hook: Turns strategy and authority into victory, leading soldiers and fleets from the front.

CONSULAR.hook: Wields the Force through diplomacy and wisdom, resolving conflicts before blades are drawn.

DIPLOMAT.hook: Wins wars without firing a shot — through words, alliances, and the careful art of persuasion.

ENGINEER.hook: Builds, repairs, and weaponizes everything the Rebellion needs to keep fighting another day.

EXPLORER.hook: Charts the unknown reaches of the galaxy where no reliable maps exist and no one comes looking.

GUARD.hook: Stands between the innocent and the darkness, channeling the Force as both shield and blade.

HIREDGUN.hook: Fights for credits, loyalty, or survival — whatever keeps the blaster in hand and the heart beating.

JEDI.hook: Carries the weight of a fallen Order, wielding lightsaber and the Force against encroaching darkness.

MYSTIC.hook: Touches the unseen currents of the Force, perceiving truths hidden from ordinary senses.

SEEKER.hook: Roams the wilds guided by the Force, hunting threats that endanger the balance of all living things.

SENTINEL.hook: Patrols the shadows of civilization, rooting out corruption the galaxy pretends does not exist.

SMUG.hook: Outruns Imperials, outtalks customs agents, and always has cargo the authorities would rather inspect.

SOLDIER.hook: Trained for frontline combat, Soldiers endure what others cannot and hold the line that matters.

SPY.hook: Operates behind enemy lines, stealing secrets and dismantling plans before they become threats.

TECHNICIAN.hook: If it has circuits, gears, or a power cell, the Technician can make it do things it was never designed to.

WAR.hook: Channels the Force into raw martial prowess, meeting every challenge blade-first and unbroken.

ADVISOR.hook: Guides leaders with quiet counsel, shaping decisions from behind the throne rather than upon it.

ADVOCATE.hook: Fights for the cause in back rooms and tribunals where speeches carry more weight than blasters.

AGGRES.hook: Weaponizes fear itself, breaking an enemy's will before the first blow ever lands.

AGITATOR.hook: Turns the Empire's own weapon — fear — back against it, igniting rebellion in occupied hearts.

ALCHEMIST.hook: Bends the Force through forbidden craft, reshaping matter in ways the Jedi Order never sanctioned.

AMBASSADOR.hook: Forges alliances across hostile borders, turning reluctant strangers into committed allies.

ANALYST.hook: Dissects intelligence reports until patterns emerge that others miss — knowledge weaponized.

ARBITER.hook: Finds the path to resolution when all others see only conflict, brokering peace through the Force.

ARCHEOLOGIST.hook: Digs through forgotten ruins for relics the galaxy buried on purpose — and some it simply lost.

ARMORER.hook: Channels the Force into crafted defenses, forging protection that turns aside blaster and blade.

ARTISAN.hook: Shapes tools and machines with Force-guided hands, crafting devices of extraordinary precision.

ASCETIC.hook: Strips away every comfort until only the Force remains — and finds absolute clarity in the void.

ASSAS.hook: A silent predator who eliminates targets before they know the hunt has begun.

ATARU.hook: Strikes with explosive acrobatic fury, ending every fight in a single devastating burst of motion.

BEASTRIDER.hook: Commands living mounts across terrain no vehicle could survive, bonded through instinct and will.

BGMHUNTER.hook: Stalks the deadliest creatures the galaxy has to offer — and brings back proof.

BODYGUARD.hook: Places their body between the principal and the threat — every time, without hesitation.

CHARMER.hook: Wields charm with surgical precision, disarming targets with a smile before they sense the danger.

CLONEOFF.hook: Commands brothers forged from the same genetic template, earning loyalty through competence alone.

CLONEPIL.hook: Takes the fight to the upper atmosphere and the void, where reflexes decide who lives.

CLONETRO.hook: The backbone of the Grand Army — first to deploy, last to leave, always advancing.

COLOSSUS.hook: Absorbs punishment that would fell lesser warriors, turning endurance into an unstoppable weapon.

COMMANDO.hook: Strikes deep behind enemy lines, completes the mission, and finds a way home through hostile ground.

COMMODORE.hook: Commands capital ships where a single tactical error can lose a fleet and a sector with it.

COURIER.hook: Carries intelligence through blockades and checkpoints where interception means summary execution.

CYBERTECH.hook: Treats the body as hardware to be upgraded — replacing flesh with something more reliable.

DEMOLITIONIST.hook: Understands the precise physics of destruction, placing charges where they do the most damage.

DOCTOR.hook: Keeps people alive on the Outer Rim, where clinics are scarce and patients rarely arrive whole.

DRIVER.hook: Masters planetside vehicles with the instinct of a pilot and the nerve of someone with nothing to lose.

DROIDSPEC.hook: Repairs, reprograms, and resurrects droids that most technicians would scrap for parts.

DROIDTECH.hook: Builds and maintains droids across every function — companions, soldiers, and everything between.

ENFORCER.hook: Backs up every negotiation with the unspoken promise of violence if diplomacy fails.

ENTREPRENEUR.hook: Turns every situation into an opportunity, building profit from chaos with ruthless efficiency.

EXECUTIONER.hook: Hunts alone in hostile wilds, dispatching threats with practiced lethality and zero hesitation.

FIGUREHEAD.hook: Leads through reputation and presence alone — followers rally to the symbol, not the strategy.

FORCEADHERENT.hook: Surrenders fully to the living Force, perceiving connections invisible to even trained adepts.

FORCESENSITIVEEMERGENT.hook: Awakens to the Force amid galactic war, learning to channel a power they barely understand.

FORCESENSITIVEEXILE.hook: Survived the Purge and lives in hiding, carrying Jedi knowledge the Empire wants erased.

FORCEOUTCAST.hook: Walks a path the Jedi and Sith never mapped, wielding the Force by instinct and desperation.

FRINGER.hook: Navigates the lawless edges of charted space where knowing the right people keeps you breathing.

GADG.hook: Compensates for terrible odds with custom gear designed to tip every encounter in their favor.

GAMBLER.hook: Reads the table, reads the room, and always knows when to fold — and when to go all in.

GUNNER.hook: Turns ship-mounted weapons into instruments of decisive, overwhelming projected force.

GUNSLINGER.hook: Draws faster, shoots straighter, and walks away from firefights most would never survive.

HEALER.hook: Channels the Force to mend wounds and cure ailments that bacta alone cannot touch.

HEAVY.hook: Brings the biggest weapon available and makes sure everyone on the battlefield knows it.

HERMIT.hook: Retreats from civilization entirely, finding in solitude a Force connection others cannot reach.

HOTSHOT.hook: Flies on raw talent and reckless nerve, pulling maneuvers that trained pilots call impossible.

HUNTER.hook: Tracks dangerous prey across untamed worlds where the predator can become the prey in an instant.

IMPERIALACADEMYCADET.hook: Trained by the Empire's own institutions before choosing a very different path forward.

INFILTRATOR.hook: Slips behind enemy lines undetected — the operative most people picture when they hear the word spy.

INSTRUCTOR.hook: Transforms raw recruits into effective fighters, passing on lessons only combat experience teaches.

INTERROGATOR.hook: Extracts critical intelligence through methods that never appear in official documentation.

INVESTIGATOR.hook: Follows evidence into the galaxy's ugliest corners, uncovering truths others have buried.

JEDIKNIGHT.hook: Serves as warrior, diplomat, and scholar — the full embodiment of the Order's ideals in the field.

JUYO.hook: Channels controlled fury through the most aggressive lightsaber form ever devised by the Order.

MAGUS.hook: Commands esoteric Force traditions so rare that even the old Jedi archives held scant record of them.

MAKASHI.hook: Duels with aristocratic precision, treating lightsaber combat as a refined art of dominance.

MARAUDER.hook: Wades into close combat dealing devastating punishment while absorbing everything thrown back.

MARSHAL.hook: Pursues criminals across lawless territories and drags them back in binders — dead or alive.

MARTIALARTIST.hook: Turns the body itself into a lethal weapon through disciplines honed across a thousand worlds.

MECHANIC.hook: Keeps everything running — the ship, the speeder, the generator — when spare parts don't exist.

MEDIC.hook: Treats battlefield casualties under fire, because the Alliance cannot afford to lose a single soldier.

MERCENARY.hook: A professional soldier who fights for pay, bringing military discipline to freelance violence.

MODDER.hook: Disassembles everyone's gear without asking and returns it working better than factory spec.

NAVIGATOR.hook: Charts courses through uncharted systems, finding safe passage where the star maps show only void.

NIMAN.hook: Blends Force powers and lightsaber technique into a balanced style suited for any confrontation.

OPERATOR.hook: Pilots pursuit vehicles with lethal precision, ensuring no target escapes once the chase begins.

OUTLAW.hook: Pushes technology past every safety limit, building custom gear from salvaged parts and nerve.

PADAWANSURVIVOR.hook: Escaped Order 66 as a child, carrying fragmented Jedi training into a galaxy that hunts survivors.

PADAWAN.hook: Walks the first steps of the Jedi path, learning to channel the Force under a master's guidance.

PATH.hook: Reads terrain the way others read datapads — no wilderness is too remote, no trail too faint.

PEACE.hook: Stands against tyranny with the Force as both weapon and shield, defending those who cannot fight.

PERFORMER.hook: Commands every room they enter, turning attention into influence and spectacle into opportunity.

PILOT.hook: Develops an almost symbiotic bond with their ship, coaxing performance no spec sheet ever promised.

PIRATE.hook: Leads boarding actions against armed vessels, taking what they want through audacity and force.

POLITICO.hook: Maneuvers through political power structures with a fluency that makes elected officials nervous.

PROPAGANDIST.hook: Shapes public perception like a weapon, turning truth into the Rebellion's most effective munition.

PROPHET.hook: Speaks of the Force's will with conviction that draws followers and unsettles skeptics in equal measure.

PROTECT.hook: Draws upon the Force to shield others from harm, placing the safety of allies above all else.

QUARTERMASTER.hook: Keeps an army fed, armed, and supplied — because empty stomachs and empty magazines lose wars.

RACER.hook: Lives for velocity, pushing every vehicle past its limits in the relentless pursuit of first place.

RECRUIT.hook: Fresh to the fight but determined to prove their worth on every battlefield the war demands.

REPNAVYOFF.hook: Coordinates Republic fleet operations, commanding warships against the Separatist armada.

REPREP.hook: Navigates the Senate's endless politics, brokering compromise across a thousand quarreling worlds.

RETIREDCLONETROOPER.hook: Bred for battle and built for war, now fighting on their own terms after the Republic fell.

RIGGER.hook: Brings a custom vehicle into combat — modified, armored, and tuned to their exact specifications.

SABOTEUR.hook: Specializes in breaking what others build, turning the enemy's infrastructure against them.

SAGE.hook: Seeks knowledge as the highest expression of the Force, knowing that wisdom outweighs strength.

SAPPER.hook: Builds fortifications and field works under fire — then rigs them to blow if the enemy gets close.

SCAVENGER.hook: Picks through the wreckage of a galaxy at war, finding value in what everyone else abandoned.

SCHOLAR.hook: Pursues knowledge across the Outer Rim, finding answers in places most academics would never survive.

SCIENTIST.hook: Innovates under impossible constraints, giving the Alliance breakthroughs that credits can't buy.

SCOUND.hook: Part con artist, part brawler, and entirely too quick to talk their way into inescapable situations.

SCOUT.hook: Goes planetside first, surveys what's waiting, and reports back — assuming they make it back.

SEER.hook: Perceives the Force's currents with constant clarity, reading fates that others cannot fathom.

SENTRY.hook: Guards the streets and corridors the Jedi legends never mention, where the real threats fester.

SHADOW.hook: Operates in the criminal underworld as the Order's unseen hand, eliminating threats from the inside.

SHARPSHOOTER.hook: Places every shot with deliberate precision, making a single bolt count more than a hundred misses.

SHIEN.hook: Turns an enemy's aggression back against them, deflecting attacks into devastating counterstrikes.

SHIICHO.hook: Masters the oldest lightsaber form — raw, sweeping, and effective against multiple opponents at once.

SHIPCAPTAIN.hook: Commands vessel and crew as one, where the captain's judgment determines everyone's survival.

SHIPWRIGHT.hook: Designs and builds starships from the keel up, launching custom vessels into the hyperspace lanes.

SKIPTRACER.hook: Hunts down debtors and fugitives through guile and persistence — blasters are a last resort.

SLEEPERAGENT.hook: Maintains a false identity for months or years, waiting for the signal to act.

SLICER.hook: Treats every secured network as a puzzle to crack, extracting data the owners thought was safe.

SORESU.hook: Adopts the most defensive lightsaber form, becoming an impenetrable wall that outlasts any attacker.

SQUADLEADER.hook: Leads small-unit tactics on the ground, where every decision under fire shapes who goes home.

STARACE.hook: Engages in starfighter combat — the most lethal form of warfare and the most exhilarating.

STEELHAND.hook: Channels the Force through unarmed strikes, proving a lightsaber is not the only weapon a Jedi wields.

STRATEGIST.hook: Sees the war entire — not individual battles, but the arc of campaigns that decide galactic fate.

SURV.hook: Thrives in environments that kill the unprepared, turning hostile terrain into home advantage.

TACTICIAN.hook: Turns captured ground into held ground, ensuring battlefield victories become lasting strategic gains.

TEACHER.hook: Passes the ways of the Force to the next generation, preserving knowledge the Empire seeks to destroy.

THIEF.hook: Operates in absolute silence, taking what is needed and vanishing before anyone knows it's gone.

TRADER.hook: Turns discovery into profit, knowing the exact price of everything the Outer Rim has to offer.

TRAILBLAZER.hook: Finds routes through impossible terrain, giving outnumbered forces the mobility to strike and vanish.

VANGUARD.hook: Hits hard, hits fast, and clears the way for everyone who follows — the tip of every spear.

WARDEN.hook: Wields gifted power with solemn duty, standing guard over those the galaxy would rather forget.

WARLEADER.hook: Inspires through action and commands through the Force, uniting warriors into a single devastating front.
